beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Hey. I actually did it — I quit."

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "But there's a lot more going on than I expected. Can we do a full reading this time — past, present, future?"

options.text: This is the leap you already took — standing at the edge, and you jumped anyway.
This means you made a huge mistake.
This card isn't really about what you just did.
That's the beginner's-mind part — it feels unfamiliar because you're seeing it fresh.
It should feel surreal, because you're not ready for this.
Surreal doesn't mean anything here.
There's a real choice ahead — one worth weighing from every angle before you commit.
It means you're going to lose someone over this.
This card just means you shouldn't trust them.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "There's someone I'd be going into business with. I don't want to drag them into something that fails."

options.text: Then choose with more than logic — trust your gut on this one too, not just the plan.
Then don't drag them into it at all.
Their feelings aren't really relevant to the choice.
Something's already been growing quietly, underneath everything else.
It means you wasted years on something pointless.
The past doesn't really factor into a reading.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "The workshop. I've been building furniture on weekends for two years and never told anyone at work."

options.text: That's exactly it — you nourished it quietly until it was ready to stand on its own.
You should have told people, that was foolish to hide.
Hiding it doesn't matter either way.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Am I actually ready for this, or did I just panic and quit?"

options.text: You didn't panic — you said yes to the unknown instead of playing it safe, same as the present card.
Honestly, it does sound like panic.
Readiness isn't something a card can answer.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "But what happens after the workshop grows into something real? I don't have a plan beyond the next few months."

options.text: You don't need the whole map yet — trust that the path appears once you take the next step.
That means there's a big decision on the horizon that needs weighing from every angle.
That means something you're nurturing right now needs protecting before it grows further.
Then hold both what you want and what they want in balance, rather than picking one.
Then it's over before it starts.
What they want doesn't need to factor in.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "If we do this together, how do I know it's actually the right partnership?"

options.text: Let more than one part of you weigh in — body, mind, and spirit all get a vote, not just the plan.
It means you should just leap in without looking too closely.
It means the partnership needs constant nurturing before it can be trusted.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Was I wrong to keep the workshop to myself this whole time?"

options.text: No — protecting something quietly while it's still forming is its own way of caring for yourself.
Yes, hiding things from people you trust is always wrong.
Whether you were wrong isn't something this reading can say.

beats.speaker: client
beats.text: "Does this mean the workshop was always meant to become something bigger?"

options.text: It means something was ready to be born — an idea finally taking real shape.
It means you're standing at the edge of something totally new, unrelated to what came before.
It means you'll need to choose between the workshop and the business partnership.

beats.speaker: reader
beats.text: For what it's worth — none of this needed to be perfect from the start. Abundance here comes from letting things flourish, not forcing them.
